Requirements.SystemGoal: Build a strict GRACE methodology orchestrator that loads development plans, generates controller packets, reviews wave gates, and produces structured execution evidence.

UseCase.Name: Load Development Plan
UseCase.Description: The system shall load a development-plan.xml from disk and parse it into structured Python objects.

UseCase.Name: Generate Controller Packet
UseCase.Description: The system shall generate a Controller Packet in Markdown format for a given wave from the development plan.

UseCase.Name: Review Wave Gate
UseCase.Description: The system shall verify changed files are within AllowedWriteScope and run verification commands.

UseCase.Name: Orchestrate Execution
UseCase.Description: The system shall run the main orchestration loop: Controller to Worker to Reviewer to advance.

InScope.Item: XML artifact parsing (development-plan, knowledge-graph, requirements, technology)

OutOfScope.Item: Network communication or remote agent execution

BusinessInvariants.Invariant: The orchestrator must never modify frozen files
All ID must follow semantic prefix convention (M-, UC-, SCN-, DEFECT-, etc.)
No external dependencies beyond Python standard library

Defect.Title: Git diff fails outside repository context
Defect.Workaround: Initialize a git repository before running the orchestrator

Defect.Title: Wave selection only supports first phase as default
Defect.Workaround: Specify explicit wave ID when working with multi-phase plans
